from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class EPSRecord(BaseModel):
    """Extracted earnings per share data from a single document."""
    company_name: str | None = Field(description="The name of the company the filing belongs to")
    reporting_period: str | None = Field(description="The time period the financial statements cover")
    share_class: str | None = Field(description="The class of shares, e.g., Common")
    eps_type: str | None = Field(description="Whether the EPS is 'Basic' or 'Diluted'")
    value: float | None = Field(description="The earnings per share amount; negative indicates a loss")
    line_item_label: str | None = Field(description="The verbatim line item label from the document")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    eps_records: list[EPSRecord]
